summary: Containerized export: back up with `ansible-playbook -i <inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.backup`, read DB settings via `podman exec` into `automation-controller-task` (`awx-manage print_settings`), `automation-hub-api` (`pulpcore-manager diffsettings`) and `automation-gateway` (`aap-gateway-manage print_settings`), check sizes with `podman exec -it postgresql bash -c 'psql -c "\l+"'`, and stage `/tmp/backups/artifact`.
questions: How do I back up containerized AAP before migration?
How do I get database settings from AAP containers?
How do I check database size in containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Start the containerized export
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i <path_to_inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.backup
podman exec -it automation-controller-task bash -c "awx-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'"
podman exec -it automation-hub-api bash -c "pulpcore-manager diffsettings | grep '^DATABASES'"
podman exec -it automation-gateway bash -c "aap-gateway-manage print_settings | grep '^DATABASES'"
podman exec -it postgresql bash -c 'psql -c "\l+"'
mkdir -p /tmp/backups/artifact/{controller,gateway,hub} /tmp/backups/artifact/controller/custom_configs
```
